observations.why: The collective 'we' combined with a decisive switch declaration enacts organizational authority — a decision made on behalf of the group, not a proposal to it.
The justification is pure proportionality — quantified benefit against cost, the cost/benefit calculus that defines market-pricing relational framing.
The memo itemizes the decision in proportionality terms — quantified performance gain and timeline — carrying the same cost/benefit framing into the formal record.
